title: 5 Minute Battery Check for Saskatoon Winters
caption: Cold mornings can drain your battery fast. Before you head out, pop the hood and clean any corrosion off the terminals, then test the voltage with a simple multimeter. A quick check now can save you a tow on a freezing Saskatoon street.
image_prompt: A hand holding a multimeter probing a car battery in a snowy Saskatoon driveway, frost on the ground, early morning light.

caption: Picture this: a Saskatoon driver, a rogue squirrel, and a mysteriously flat tire. Spoiler: the squirrel loses, and you get a fast mobile fix. Follow us for more unexpected roadside drama!

title: Don’t Ignore These Brake Warning Signs
caption: If you hear squealing, feel a soft pedal, or notice the car pulling to one side, your brakes may need attention right away. In Saskatoon’s winter roads, reliable brakes are a must‑have. Contact us for a quick inspection before your next drive.
image_prompt: Close-up of a car brake disc with visible wear, set against a snowy Saskatoon street background, warning signs like a red exclamation mark.
